{{Navbar-Global_Coal_Plant_Tracker}}
'''Heshun power station''' (潞安星光煤电公司和顺煤矸石发电厂) is a cancelled power station in Heshun County, Jinzhong, Shanxi, China.
It is also known as Lu'an Xingguang Heshun LHV Coal Power Plant, 山西国际能源和顺星光低热值煤发电.

==Background==

Heshun power station is a proposed 2 x 350 MW waste coal plant in Heshun County.<ref>[http://www.sxcoal.com/coal/4183809/articlenew.html "潞安集团加快星光低热值煤项目实施,"] 中国煤炭资源网, 2015年07月01日</ref> 

===Nationwide Restrictions Imposed on Development of Coal-Fired Power Capacity===
In January 2017 China's National Energy Administration suspended over 100 planned and under-construction coal power projects with a total capacity of over 100GW in 13 provinces, including Heshun power station. In response, Shanxi International Energy Group voluntarily cancelled the coal plant.<ref>[http://news.bjx.com.cn/html/20170116/803648.shtml "能源局下发13省市新建火电机组停建清单(附文件),"] Polaris, Jan 16, 2017</ref>

For details, see [[China's 2016 Restrictions on Development of Coal-Fired Power Capacity]].
